28531-the-banner-boy-scouts-snowbound-or.title: A Tour on Skates and Iceboats
28531-the-banner-boy-scouts-snowbound-or.creator: George A. Warren
28531-the-banner-boy-scouts-snowbound-or.description: A book by George A. Warren. Once more it is my privilege to offer you a new volume wherein I have endeavored to relate further interesting adventures in which the members of Stanhope Troop of Boy Scouts take part. Most of my readers, I feel sure, remember Paul, Jud, Bobolink, Jack and many of the other characters, and will gladly greet them as old friends.

arxiv-1704-02813.title: Character-Word LSTM Language Models
arxiv-1704-02813.creator: Lyan Verwimp, Joris Pelemans, Hugo Van hamme, Patrick Wambacq
arxiv-1704-02813.description: Abstract We present a Character-Word Long Short-Term Memory Language Model which both reduces the perplexity with respect to a baseline word-level language model and reduces the number of parameters of the model. Character information can reveal structural (dis)similarities between words and can even be used when a word is out-of-vocabulary, thus improving the modeling of infrequent and unknown words.

arxiv-1709-06218.title: Almost-linear time decoding algorithm for topological codes
arxiv-1709-06218.creator: Nicolas Delfosse, Naomi H. Nickerson
arxiv-1709-06218.description: Abstract In order to build a large scale quantum computer, one must be able to correct errors extremely fast. We design a fast decoding algorithm for topological codes to correct for Pauli errors and erasure and combination of both errors and erasure.

arxiv-2010-06874.title: The charmed string: self-supporting loops through air drag
arxiv-2010-06874.creator: Adrian Daerr 1, Juliette Courson 1, Margaux Abello 1, Wladimir Toutain 1, Bruno Andreotti 2
arxiv-2010-06874.description: Abstract The string shooter experiment uses counter-rotating pulleys to propel a closed string forward. Its steady state exhibits a transition from a gravity dominated regime at low velocity towards a high velocity regime where the string takes the form of a self-supporting loop.

arxiv-2107-09728.title: Machine Learning Approaches to Automated Flow Cytometry Diagnosis of Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia.
arxiv-2107-09728.creator: Akum S. Kang 1,2, Loveleen C. Kang MD 3,4, Stephen M. Mastorides MD 3,4, Philip R. Foulis MD 3,4, Lauren A. DeLand NP 3, Robert P. Seifert, MD 5, Andrew A. Borkowski MD 2,3,4
arxiv-2107-09728.description: Abstract Flow cytometry is a technique that measures multiple fluorescence and light scatter-associated parameters from individual cells as they flow a single file through an excitation light source. These cells are labeled with antibodies to detect various antigens and the fluorescence signals reflect antigen expression. Interpretation of the multiparameter flow cytometry data is laborious, time-consuming, and expensive.

arxiv-2210-03174.title: Prudent walk in dimension six and higher
arxiv-2210-03174.creator: Markus HEYDENREICH, Lorenzo TAGGI, Niccolò TORRI
arxiv-2210-03174.description: Abstract We study the high-dimensional uniform prudent self-avoiding walk, which assigns equal probability to all nearest-neighbor self-avoiding paths of a fixed length that respect the prudent condition, namely, the path cannot take any step in the direction of a previously visited site.

arxiv-2303-11688.title: Helitronics for classical and unconventional computing
arxiv-2303-11688.creator: N. T. Bechler \href https://orcid.org/0009-0006-6824-3537, J. Masell \href https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9951-4452
arxiv-2303-11688.description: Abstract Magnetic textures are promising candidates for unconventional computing due to their non-linear dynamics. We propose to investigate the rich variety of seemingly trivial lamellar magnetic phases, e.g., helical, spiral, stripy phase, or other one-dimensional soliton lattices. These are the natural stray field-free ground states of almost every magnet.

arxiv-2402-13671.title: KInIT at SemEval-2024 Task 8: Fine-tuned LLMs for Multilingual Machine-Generated Text Detection
arxiv-2402-13671.creator: Michal Spiegel, Dominik Macko
arxiv-2402-13671.description: Abstract SemEval-2024 Task 8 is focused on multigenerator, multidomain, and multilingual black-box machine-generated text detection. Such a detection is important for preventing a potential misuse of large language models (LLMs), the newest of which are very capable in generating multilingual human-like texts.

arxiv-2403-18055.title: Adaptive Boundary Control of the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky Equation Under Intermittent Sensing
arxiv-2403-18055.creator: M. C. Belhadjoudja, M. Maghenem, E. Witrant, C. Prieur
arxiv-2403-18055.description: Abstract We study in this paper boundary stabilization, in the L 2 L^{2} sense, of the perturbed Kuramoto-Sivashinsky (KS) equation subject to intermittent sensing. We assume that we measure the state on a given spatial subdomain during certain time intervals, while we measure the state on the remaining spatial subdomain during the remaining time intervals.

arxiv-2411-19628.title: Accelerating Multimodal Large Language Models via Dynamic Visual-Token Exit and Empirical Findings
arxiv-2411-19628.creator: Qiong Wu, Wenhao Lin, Yiyi Zhou, Weihao Ye, Zhanpeng Zeng, Xiaoshuai Sun, Rongrong Ji
arxiv-2411-19628.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the visual redundancy problem of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) from the perspective of attention behaviors. Via extensive empirical experiments, we observe and conclude three main inference stages of MLLMs: (i) Early fusion between tokens is first accomplished quickly. (ii) Intra-modality modeling then comes to play.

arxiv-2502-04968.title: Duality of Selmer groups of an abelian variety over a number field
arxiv-2502-04968.creator: Saikat Biswas
arxiv-2502-04968.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Saikat Biswas. Let A A be an abelian variety defined over a number field K K and let A ∨ A^{\vee} be the dual abelian variety. For an odd prime p p , we consider two Selmer groups attached to A ⁡ [ p ] A[p] and relate the orders of these groups along with those of their corresponding duals to the order of the component groups of A ∨ A^{\vee} at primes v v .

arxiv-2503-13961.title: BG-Triangle: Bézier Gaussian Triangle for 3D Vectorization and Rendering
arxiv-2503-13961.creator: Minye Wu, Haizhao Dai, Kaixin Yao, Tinne Tuytelaars, Jingyi Yu
arxiv-2503-13961.description: Abstract Differentiable rendering enables efficient optimization by allowing gradients to be computed through the rendering process, facilitating 3D reconstruction, inverse rendering and neural scene representation learning. To ensure differentiability, existing solutions approximate or re-formulate traditional rendering operations using smooth, probabilistic proxies such as volumes or Gaussian primitives.

arxiv-2504-15072.title: Rhythm of Opinion: A Hawkes-Graph Framework for Dynamic Propagation Analysis
arxiv-2504-15072.creator: Yulong Li, Zhixiang Lu, Feilong Tang, Simin Lai, Ming Hu, Yuxuan Zhang, Haochen Xue, Zhaodong Wu, Imran Razzak, Qingxia Li, Jionglong Su, School of Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Computing, Xi’an Jiaotong-Liverpool University, Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence, Monash Uni
arxiv-2504-15072.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yulong Li, Zhixiang Lu, Feilong Tang, Simin Lai, Ming Hu, Yuxuan Zhang, Haochen Xue, Zhaodong Wu, Imran Razzak, Qingxia Li, Jionglong Su, School of Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Computing, Xi’an Jiaotong-Liverpool University, Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence, Monash Uni. The rapid development of social media has significantly reshaped the dynamics of public opinion, resulting in complex interactions that traditional models fail to effectively capture.

arxiv-2512-02150.title: J 1 − J 2 J_{1}-J_{2} Triangular Lattice Antiferromagnet in a Magnetic Field
arxiv-2512-02150.creator: Anna Keselman, Xinyuan Xu, Hao Zhang, Cristian D. Batista, Oleg A. Starykh
arxiv-2512-02150.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Anna Keselman, Xinyuan Xu, Hao Zhang, Cristian D. Batista, Oleg A. Starykh. We investigate the spin- 1 2 \tfrac{1}{2} J 1 J_{1} – J 2 J_{2} triangular-lattice Heisenberg antiferromagnet in a magnetic field by combining large-scale density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) simulations with self-consistent spin-wave theory. The resulting field–coupling phase diagram reveals that quantum fluctuations stabilize coplanar order across the entire parameter range, giving rise to a characteristic sequence of magnetization plateaux.

arxiv-2512-08044.title: Effect of superconductivity on non-uniform magnetization in dirty SF junctions
arxiv-2512-08044.creator: A. V. Levin, P. M. Ostrovsky
arxiv-2512-08044.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by A. V. Levin, P. M. Ostrovsky. We study proximity effect in a tunnel junction between a bulk superconductor and a thin disordered ferromagnetic layer on its surface. Cooper pairs penetrating from the superconductor into the ferromagnet tend to destabilize its uniform magnetic order. The competition of this effect and the intrinsic magnetic stiffness of the ferromagnet leads to a second order phase transition between uniform and non-uniform magnetic states.

pmc-12451970.title: Roxadustat alleviates cisplatin-induced acute kidney injury by regulating fatty acid oxidation and mitochondrial function
pmc-12451970.creator: Xialin Li, Yan Hu, Jinqing Li, Yingfeng Shi, Qin Zhong, Xiaoyan Ma, Daofang Jiang, Shasha Zhang, Shougang Zhuang, Na Liu
pmc-12451970.description: AimsThis study aimed to elucidate the role and function of roxadustat, a small molecule hypoxia-inducible factor (HIF) stabilizer, on cisplatin-induced acute kidney injury (AKI) in vivo and in vitro.MethodsWe investigated the effects of roxadustat (10 mg/kg) in a cisplatin-induced AKI model in mice.

pmc-13586536.title: Deadenylation and decapping factors cooperatively stimulate biochemical activities of DEAD-box ATPase Dhh1
pmc-13586536.creator: Gabriel A Braun, Rakesh Kumar, Alan G Hinnebusch, John D Gross
pmc-13586536.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The DEAD-box ATPase Dhh1 (DDX6 in humans) is a general activator of 5′-3′ mRNA decay that acts between the deadenylation and decapping steps of the pathway, although the exact mechanism of its action remains unclear. Dhh1 has been shown to interact with the MIF4G domain of the central scaffold protein of the Ccr4–Not deadenylase complex, Not1, as well as the decapping activator Edc3.

pmc-13656495.title: Fulminant truncal necrotizing fasciitis of perianal origin with mediastinal extension: a case report
pmc-13656495.creator: Haoyan Li, Chaoyun Chen, Ziwen Wang, Huacong Zhu, Lisi Jian, Lu Zhou, Shiwei Chen, Yang Li
pmc-13656495.description: BackgroundNecrotizing fasciitis (NF) is a rare but life-threatening soft-tissue infection characterized by rapidly progressive necrosis of the fascia and subcutaneous tissue. Early manifestations are often nonspecific, and delayed diagnosis is associated with substantial mortality. Early recognition and immediate intervention are critical to improving outcomes.

pmc-13694444.title: Regimen-Related Oral Mucosal Injury: Pathobiology, Clinical Consequences and Rationale for Intervention Across Cancer Treatment Modalities
pmc-13694444.creator: Stephen Sonis, Hannah Wardill, Alessandro Villa
pmc-13694444.description: Purpose of ReviewMucosal injury of the alimentary tract (mucositis) has been a consistent, markedly symptomatic, and clinically disruptive side effect of conventional cytotoxic chemotherapy and radiotherapy regimens since their inception. Despite its impact, mucositis remains a significant unmet clinical need as available treatment options are sparse.

uslaw-usc-t21-s350d.description: United States Code, Title 21 (Food And Drugs); Chapter 9 (Federal Food, Drug, And Cosmetic Act); Subchapter IV (Food). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Registration (1) In general The Secretary shall by regulation require that any facility engaged in manufacturing, processing, packing, or holding food for consumption in the United States be registered with the Secretary. To be registered— (A) for.
